name: Evan Crawford
original_name: エヴァン・クロフォード
source:
A university professor who teaches at an academy in the united kingdom, he does
things at his own pace.

He may appear to be a gentle British gentleman at a glance, but he also has a side that can easily throw those around him off balance.

Evan has an aura that gives off a sense of danger.
He has a strong interest in the legends of Mirage.
